title: Waverly Place Double Glass Shelf With Gallery Rail, 16-Inch X 5-Inch, Allied Brass
body_html:
Need more bathroom storage without adding clutter? This double glass shelf gives you two levels for toiletries and décor, with a gallery rail that keeps items securely in place.

  • Organize more in less space with a double-tier shelf design that uses vertical wall area
  • Keep bottles from sliding thanks to the integrated gallery rail
  • Choose strength you can count on with 3/8-inch thick tempered glass
  • Coordinate a cohesive look with the Waverly Place collection for matching Waverly Place pieces
  • Get a clean, finished installation with concealed screw mounting hardware

Specs & Installation

  • Glass dimensions (each shelf): 16-Inch x 5-Inch
  • Overall dimensions: 16-Inch L x 5-Inch projection x 8-Inch H
  • Materials: tempered glass shelves; solid brass hardware
  • Mounting type: wall mount (concealed screw mounting)
  • Weight capacity: 4 lb
  • Product weight: 10.4 lb
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included: glass shelf and all installation hardware
  • Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4"

Designed for transitional bathroom hardware layouts and versatile bath accessories, this shelf pairs easily with other pieces in the Waverly Place collection.
